Haron Freitas Lourenzoni is a visiting BSc student with the CCWJ from the University of São Paulo (USP) in Brazil. His work with the CCWJ focuses on additive manufacturing using wire arc deposition.

Outside of work, Haron enjoys listening to music, shielded metal arc welding (SMAW), and exploring new places and environments.

####### Prior Degrees

BSc (ongoing), Mechatronic Engineering, University of São Paulo (USP), Brazil
